children: NN completed a private placement, entering a Securities Purchase Agreement to sell 11,275,605 common shares and issue pre-funded warrants for up to 4,824,395 additional shares. Priced at $3.30 per share and $3.29 per pre-funded warrant, the transaction delivered approximately $53 million in gross proceeds and about $50 million net at the October 5, 2026 closing. The pre-funded warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.01 per share and do not expire. In a related move, NN signed a Registration Rights Agreement requiring it to file a resale registration within 45 days and seek effectiveness within 45 to 90 days, with liquidated damages if timelines are missed.
